risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI sector correction from leadership-driven slowdown narrative
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce concentrated AI exposure; rotate to infrastructure, non-AI tech, and AI-adjacent plays (data centers, power); maintain cash for entry on oversold levels

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil supply shock and Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities or oil calls; reduce import-heavy consumer exposure; monitor Houthi/Hormuz developments daily; consider TLT as inflation hedge

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike and rising bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; lock in CD rates at 4.35%; avoid long-duration equities; monitor Warsh/Trump policy conflict for volatility spikes

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China economic slowdown and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit China direct exposure; favor companies with China rebound optionality (STAA) over pure China plays; monitor FX hedging guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage rate surge and housing affordability crisis
risk_assessment.mitigation: Lock in fixed rates if refinancing; favor homebuilder guidance raises (LGIH) over rate-sensitive REITs; monitor Treasury buyback effectiveness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical spillover to Gulf/UAE and shipping
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from single-region exposure; monitor UAE economic indicators; track shipping cost inflation

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from AI application stocks into AI infrastructure and non-AI tech (power, data centers, semiconductors for non-AI use)
opportunities.rationale: AI slowdown narrative hits application layer hardest; infrastructure demand persists regardless of model pace; Cramer's pick over DRAM signals rotation

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure via integrated oil majors and pipeline operators
opportunities.rationale: Brent at $108 with supply disruption; Houthi threat to Hormuz creates sustained premium; Asian refiners scrambling for supply

opportunities.recommendation: Buy the dip in quality CRE (malls) and consumer staples with tariff refund tailwinds
opportunities.rationale: Malls top CRE performer; Arhaus blowout on tariff refunds; L.L.Bean no-AI model gaining; consumer experience economy resilient

opportunities.recommendation: Position in 2-year Treasuries and short-duration bonds as growth-slowdown insurance
opportunities.rationale: Amundi's move validates; if oil-driven recession risk materializes, short end benefits from rate cut expectations; CD at 4.35% offers yield

opportunities.recommendation: Consider Novo Nordisk over Eli Lilly on upcoming catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Key catalyst could shift GLP-1 competitive dynamics; pharma rotation opportunity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce net long equity beta by 15-20%; increase cash or T-bill allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Dual shock (AI selloff + oil spike + Fed hike) creates correlated downside; Buffett's 'fearful when greedy' signal active; futures falling across indices

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge oil exposure with long-dated energy calls or sector ETFs; avoid unhedged import-heavy portfolios
defensive_moves.rationale: Hormuz closure risk is binary and severe; $108 Brent could spike to $120+; transport and consumer margins compress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Lock in mortgage/CD rates before further hikes; avoid variable-rate debt
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage rates surging daily; Fed hike imminent; 4.35% CD APY is attractive vs. rising opportunity cost

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim or hedge China-exposed positions; favor companies with China optionality over pure exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit expansion miss signals structural weakness; loan demand sags; but tariff-return dynamic creates selective opportunities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid overleveraged AI startups and high-valuation names (Databricks $190B questioned)
defensive_moves.rationale: AI slowdown narrative pressures funding cycles; valuation math 'doesn't add up yet'; Intrepid Growth fund suggests selective, not broad, AI investing

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. AI selloff and oil spike create 5-10% index drawdown risk in 1-3 weeks. Fed hike expectations and Warsh/Trump tension add policy uncertainty. Energy and short-duration bonds outperform. Tech leadership fractures. Expect 2-3% weekly volatility in equities.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI slowdown calls are cyclical, not structural; infrastructure demand persists. Oil shock is geopolitical, not demand-driven, and should normalize. China weakness is gradual. Malls/CRE recovery and consumer resilience support 6-12 month equity recovery. Key risk: if Houthi escalation becomes sustained, stagflation scenario dominates.
